tools.name: search_vacancies
tools.description: Use this when the user asks for current job openings with explicit filters (country, keywords, city, number of results). Returns the newest matching vacancies (max 20, paginate with offset) with salary, employer, city, posting date and a link to apply on finder.work or a Finder country site, plus a link to the matching listing page. Do not use for salary statistics (use salary_stats) or for countries not listed in list_countries. Country codes: ru (finder.work, Russia), by, kz, kg, de, fr, be, ch, se, id, at, ar, ec, pa, gb, ie, cz, uz, no, sk, bg, fi, es, pl, sg, nz, mx, co, au, us, cl, pe, cr, gt, ca, nl, it, ro, cy, uy, do, ni, py, hr, si, lv, mt, lu, in, za, ke, hu, ng, ph, gh, ug, hn, sv, pt, tn.

country.description: Country ISO code: ru (Russia, finder.work), by, kz, kg, de, fr, be, ch, se, id, at, ar, ec, pa, gb, ie, cz, uz, no, sk, bg, fi, es, pl, sg, nz, mx, co, au, us, cl, pe, cr, gt, ca, nl, it, ro, cy, uy, do, ni, py, hr, si, lv, mt, lu, in, za, ke, hu, ng, ph, gh, ug, hn, sv, pt, tn. Call list_countries if unsure.
country.title: Country

query.description: Job title or keywords in any language, e.g. 'бухгалтер', 'python developer'. Empty = newest vacancies
query.title: Query

city.description: City where the user wants to work (search filter), as written locally, e.g. 'Минск', 'Алматы', 'Berlin'. Not the user's current location; do not pass coordinates or addresses. Empty = whole country
city.title: City

tools.name: get_vacancy
tools.description: Use this when you already have a vacancy id from search_vacancies and need its full details (description up to 8,000 characters, salary, experience, employment type, active status) and the page where the user can apply. For Russian vacancies (finder.work) pass country='ru'; for other countries country may be omitted. Do not use to search.

country.description: Pass 'ru' for Russian (finder.work) vacancies; empty or the country code for other countries
country.title: Country

tools.name: salary_stats
tools.description: Use this when the user asks how much a profession pays in a country or city. Returns the median salary, the spread (25th-75th percentile on country sites, or mean and 1-sigma range for Russia; see `method`), the sample size of active vacancies, the currency and period, and a link to the Finder salary page for that profession and city. Figures are computed from advertised salaries in active vacancies, not from payroll data. Do not use to list vacancies.

country.description: Country ISO code: ru (Russia, finder.work), by, kz, kg, de, fr, be, ch, se, id, at, ar, ec, pa, gb, ie, cz, uz, no, sk, bg, fi, es, pl, sg, nz, mx, co, au, us, cl, pe, cr, gt, ca, nl, it, ro, cy, uy, do, ni, py, hr, si, lv, mt, lu, in, za, ke, hu, ng, ph, gh, ug, hn, sv, pt, tn. Call list_countries if unsure.
country.title: Country

profession.description: Profession in the local language, e.g. 'Бухгалтер', 'Programmierer'. Empty = all jobs
profession.title: Profession

city.description: City where the user wants to work (search filter), as written locally, e.g. 'Минск', 'Алматы', 'Berlin'. Not the user's current location; do not pass coordinates or addresses. Empty = whole country
city.title: City

tools.name: list_countries
tools.description: Use this when you need the list of supported countries and their Finder sites before calling other tools. Do not use to search vacancies.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to find job vacancies, a list of jobs for a profession and city, or salary levels for a profession on Finder (finder.work for Russia and *.finder.work country sites). Returns up to 10 results with id, title and canonical finder.work URL; call fetch with an id to read the full vacancy, listing or salary page. Do not use for writing resumes, career advice without job data, applying to a job, or contacting employers: this tool only reads public data. Examples: "бухгалтер Казань", "удалённая работа python", "зарплата водителя в Москве".

query.description: Natural-language job or salary question, e.g. 'бухгалтер Казань', 'python developer Berlin remote', 'зарплата водителя в Москве'
query.title: Query

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Use this after search to read the full content of one Finder result by its id: a vacancy (description, salary, employer, city, posting date, active/archived), a job listing page (count, median salary, top vacancies) or a salary page (median, range, sample size, methodology). Returns the canonical URL for citation. Do not use with ids that did not come from search.

id.description: Result id returned by search, e.g. 'ru:vacancy:37931062'
id.title: Id
